background_story: Tiger was a legendary steam locomotive known for its distinctive churr-churr sound as it chugged along the tracks. Built in the early 20th century, Tiger was designed for hauling heavy loads across the rugged terrain of the American West. Its powerful engine and sturdy frame made it a reliable workhorse, earning the respect of railroad workers and passengers alike. As Tiger chugged along, its churr-churr sound echoed through the valleys and canyons, a reassuring signal that the train was on its way. Despite being retired from service decades ago, Tiger remains a beloved relic of the past, its churr-churr sound still evoking memories of a bygone era.
